steps.en: OCMS has already sent the electronic reminder to the hirer.
steps.id: OCMS sudah mengirim reminder elektronik ke hirer.
steps.why_en: The reminder job is off in production and company hirers get no email at this stage.
steps.why_id: Job reminder mati di production dan hirer company tidak mendapat email di stage ini.

steps.en: OCMS checks whether the hirer opted out of electronic reminders.
steps.id: OCMS mengecek apakah hirer memilih tidak menerima reminder elektronik.
steps.why_en: The check runs inside the reminder job, which is off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan berjalan di dalam job reminder yang mati di production.

steps.en: OCMS picks hirer notices heading for the 3rd letter to check with MHA.
steps.id: OCMS memilih notice hirer yang menuju surat ketiga untuk dicek ke MHA.

steps.en: OCMS receives the hirer's latest details from MHA and updates the record.
steps.id: OCMS menerima data terbaru hirer dari MHA dan memperbarui record.
steps.why_en: What MHA actually returns cannot be checked here, and one related fix is still in testing.
steps.why_id: Isi balasan MHA yang sebenarnya tidak bisa dicek di sini, dan satu perbaikan terkait masih diuji.

steps.en: Hirers with FIN or company ID are checked through the data source.
steps.id: Hirer dengan FIN atau ID company dicek lewat sumber data.
steps.why_en: That check is switched off in production, so these hirers are not updated.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan itu dimatikan di production, jadi hirer ini tidak diperbarui.

steps.en: After the 2nd letter, the notice moves on to the 3rd letter stage.
steps.id: Setelah surat kedua, notice naik ke stage surat ketiga.
steps.why_en: The notice moves on even when the 2nd letter file never reached the vendor.
steps.why_id: Notice naik walau file surat kedua tidak sampai ke vendor.

steps.en: Checked hirers can get the 3rd letter; suspended notices are left out.
steps.id: Hirer yang sudah dicek bisa dikirimi surat ketiga; notice yang disuspend dilewati.
steps.why_en: Nothing makes the 3rd letter wait for the check results, so a late result means an old address.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang membuat surat ketiga menunggu hasil pengecekan, jadi hasil yang telat berarti alamat lama.
